KOREAN–UKRAINIAN PHONETIC SYSTEM
ADVERSARIAL TEXT CORPUS COLLECTION
Version: 2026-10-11

SIZE
----
15 broad thematic corpora (01–15) plus 150 rule-family corpora:
30 families × 5 TXT files each = 165 corpus inputs, plus this index.

The rule-family files present target forms as quoted, independent examples. This is deliberate:
corpus construction must not accidentally attach arbitrary particles or endings to examples
(e.g. turning 같이 into the nonexistent test token 같이와). Multiword phrases are preserved
inside quotation marks in the connected-speech and rule-chain groups.

RULE FAMILIES
-------------
General principles; consonant contrasts; vowel contrasts; ㅚ/ㅟ; ㅢ; vowel length; final
neutralization; simple codas; complex codas; ㄺ; 밟-; 넓-; liaison with particles; liaison
with endings; palatalization; nasalization; liquid assimilation; ㅎ and aspiration; coda-
conditioned fortition; morphological/lexical fortition; ㄴ insertion; insertion controls;
coda+ㄹ; complex coda+nasalization; connected speech; verb inflection; adjective inflection;
names and loanwords; rule chains; and negative controls.

The numeric IDs are corpus group IDs, not a claim that every file maps one-to-one to one
numbered paragraph of the official regulation. Verify exact examples against the National
Institute of Korean Language before promoting any item to a normative gold test.

The corpus files are stress inputs, not gold-standard outputs. They do not prescribe one
Ukrainian output. A successful engine run proves runtime compatibility, not pronunciation
correctness. Preserve uncertainty for cases that need morphological or lexical evidence.
